plainText:
Nandy (Japanese: ナンディ Nandi) and Mokichi (Japanese: モキチ Mokichi) are characters of the day who appeared in Food Fit for a Kingambit!. They are a married couple who own and work at Anything Goes Café, a restaurant located in Medali. According to Mokichi, he and Nandy met when his 's yell caused Nandy to throw her back, which he apologized for by taking her to his restaurant.

==History==
Liko, Roy, and Dot met Nandy and Mokichi when they came to eat at the restaurant. When Dot's Tinkatink wrecked Mokichi's iron griddle, the three were forced to work at the restaurant for a day to pay up for it. They learned that the restaurant was struggling due to 's popularity and did their best to get more customers to visit the eatery. Dot eventually figured out that the restaurant's overly complex signature dish was the source behind people not revisiting it and told Nandy and Mokichi to simplify the dish to focus on its tastiest part: the made by Kingambit. Dot's plan worked, livening up Anything Goes Café, much to Nandy and Mokichi's joy.
